title: Finite concatenation of operadic colimit cocones
statement:
Use monoidal infinity categories of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category], small simplicial sets and coherent functors of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the active cocones, concatenation $\oplus$ and operadic colimit condition of [def-coef-operadic-correspondence]. Let $r\geq0$ and let $c_i:K_i^{\triangleright}\to\mathcal V^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}}$, $1\leq i\leq r$, be operadically colimiting cocones in an arbitrary monoidal infinity category. Put $K=\prod_iK_i$. The cocone
$$K^{\triangleright}\longrightarrow\prod_iK_i^{\triangleright}\xrightarrow{\prod_i c_i}(\mathcal V^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}})^r\xrightarrow{\oplus}\mathcal V^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}}$$
is operadically colimiting. Its apex is the concatenation of the apices of the $c_i$. For $r=0$, $K$ is the one-point simplicial set and this is the constant identity cocone on the empty tuple. This assertion includes empty $K_i$ and does not assume the existence of any additional colimits or global preservation of colimits by tensoring.

source.place: Proposition 3.1.1.8, printed pp. 321–322; GH Proposition A.2.4. Nonsymmetric formulation following Gepner–Haugseng, arXiv:1312.3178v4 Appendix A. Read online; archive WANTED. No Stacks tag states this infinity-categorical fact.
